sentences.en: They want to build a hotel in proximity to the beach.
sentences.zh: 他们想在靠近海滩的地方建一家酒店。

sentences.en: The big change is the proximity to death.
sentences.zh: 这个重大变化是与死亡的临近。

sentences.en: Blind people sometimes develop a compensatory ability to sense the proximity of objects around them.
sentences.zh: 有时候，盲人会发展出一种补偿能力，能够感知周围物体的接近程度。

senses.zh: 接近，[数]邻近；接近；接近度，距离；亲近
